title: Jude and the Visitor
author: M. M. Nystrom
blurb: Noor Lockridge, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
